narrative.incident_description: Vulnerability exposure - DEMO-VULN-001 has been identified on asset PWR-HMI-01 (hostname scada-hmi-01, IP 10.10.1.21, sector power). The installed version 4.2.1 falls within the vulnerable range (>=4.0.0, <4.2.3). The asset is a critical SCADA HMI workstation (criticality 5) and is not internet-facing. No exploitation has been observed in the available evidence.
recommended_next_actions: Confirm scope: verify the affected assets and whether the activity/exposure is real
Preserve relevant logs (CERT-In Directions require ICT system logs to be retained for 180 days)
Apply the vendor patch or mitigation, or restrict exposure until patched
Hunt for signs of exploitation; if found, reassess reportability (6-hour clock starts when noticed)
